title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Terms: Statement Deferral for Long-Standing Tenants Bringing an Agreement Current
content:
**Term.** When a delinquent Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement is brought current, a tenant who has held the agreement at least 36 months and made at least 10 payments on it in the last 12 months has $10.00 left on the next statement; a tenant who has held it at least 12 months but fewer than 36 months and made at least 6 payments on it in that time has $5.00 left on it; every other tenant leaves nothing under this term. The amount left is left on the next statement rather than collected: it is taken off the amount to pay now, and the result is rounded to the cent.

**Definitions.**
- Months held: whole calendar months from the agreement's start date to the handling date, counted to the same day of the later month (or that month's last day where the day does not exist).
- Payments: payment entries on the agreement's ledger dated in the window. A window of the last 12 months covers ledger entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month.

**Conditions shown in combination.**

| Months held | Payments in the last 12 months | Left on the next statement |
|---|---|---|
| 36 or more | 10 or more | $10.00 |
| 36 or more | fewer than 10 | nothing |
| 12 to 35 | 6 or more | $5.00 |
| 12 to 35 | fewer than 6 | nothing |
| fewer than 12 | any | nothing |

Hypothetical example: a tenant at exactly 36 months with exactly 10 payments in the window, catching up an agreement whose amount to pay is otherwise $212.40, has $10.00 left on the next statement and pays $202.40 now.
